function.name: wildlife_population_assess_growth
function.description: Assesses the population growth of a specific species in a specified location over a period. Unlike ecological_impact_analyze, which analyzes the impact of a species on a particular ecosystem, this assesses the population growth of a specific species in a specified location over a period.

species.description: The species for which the growth is to be calculated.

location.description: The area where the species is present.

duration.description: The time period for which the population growth should be calculated in years.

function.name: ecological_impact_analyze
function.description: Analyzes the impact of a species on a particular ecosystem. Unlike wildlife_population_assess_growth, which assesses the population growth of a specific species in a specified location over a period, this analyzes the impact of a species on a particular ecosystem.

species.description: The species whose impact is to be calculated.

location.description: The area where the impact is analyzed.

timeframe.description: The time period for which the impact analysis should be carried out in years.
